title_o: A needs-based model of reconciliation: Satisfying the differential emotional needs of victim and perpetrator as a key to promoting reconciliation.
verdict_reason: The .sav (guid 8y94x) has 146 rows, 141 with AvgWillingReconcileTime2 and both factor codes; the audit script's 2x2 between ANOVA, run in base R, gives the role x message interaction F(1,137)=1.425, p=.235, partial eta^2=.0103, matching the table. The script as written fails on current foreign because value labels turn the DV into a factor; use.value.labels=FALSE fixes it.
